006package dev.metaschema.core.datatype;
007
008import java.util.Objects;
009
010import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
011import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
012
013/**
014 * A common base implementation of a custom Java object providing an underlying
015 * implementation of a data type.
016 *
017 * @param <TYPE>
018 *          the bound object type supported by this data type
019 * @param <VALUE>
020 *          the inner value of the data type object
021 */
022public abstract class AbstractCustomJavaDataType<TYPE extends ICustomJavaDataType<TYPE>, VALUE>
023    implements ICustomJavaDataType<TYPE> {
024  @NonNull
025  private final VALUE value;
026
027  /**
028   * Construct a new instance of a custom Java object-based data value.
029   *
030   * @param value
031   *          the bound object that the data type is based on
032   */
033  protected AbstractCustomJavaDataType(@NonNull VALUE value) {
034    this.value = ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(value, "value");
035  }
036
037  /**
038   * Get the bound Java object value.
039   *
040   * @return the bound object
041   */
042  @NonNull
043  public VALUE getValue() {
044    return value;
045  }
046  //
047  // public void setValue(T value) {
048  // this.value = value;
049  // }
050
051  @Override
052  public int hashCode() {
053    return value.hashCode();
054  }
055
056  @Override
057  public boolean equals(Object obj) {
058    return Objects.equals(value, obj);
059  }
060
061  @Override
062  public String toString() {
063    return value.toString();
064  }
065}
